author: James (Blogger)
text_post: This is one of my greatest fears as a father. Failure as a parent. While I don't have little girls, I did have two boys who are now adults. But youth itself comes with a price. Young people who are budding adults still act at times with little foresight as too their many choices. So I have recently found myself many times asking myself, did I allow them the freedom to grow up with a sense of pride and self respect? Did I instill in them some wisdom to weight the right decision? As parents we often walk a fine line and question ourselves many times which line might have been cross. I can only guess that in the end, we hope and pray, that we tried to do the best we can and maintain a faith it will somehow work itself out that benefits them the most. I like to add that these three words hope praying and faith aren't easy for me to hang unto too, but as I get older. Sometimes it's all I have too hang on to. I can only conclude that old age to comes with a price.
